item: Row 255: the WAL soak decides which checkpoint attempts are evidence by the scan's own sequence and the log's measured size, never by comparing two threads' clocks
summary: Release note: no change you can see; a test that failed on macOS runners now judges what it means to. Cause measured: a TRUNCATE checkpoint of an EMPTY log answers busy=0 under a reader that holds its snapshot, so on a runner whose writer had not committed yet the never-releasing mutants were counted as cleared. Reproduced with a held writer: the old clock window judged the mutant green, the new evidence rule finds no evidence and calls the round inconclusive.
